tools.name: get_submission_status
tools.title: Check your submission status
tools.description: Reads the current stored review status of one RoboDebut submission, identified by the secret status_receipt returned only to the request that created it. Has no homepage or email lookup and cannot recover legacy or lost receipts; public approval is also visible on RoboDebut's public pages. Does not recheck the homepage, submit, edit, approve, notify or contact other services. Returns a status. The outcome determines whether the response includes a plain-language human_message, a public listing URL or a retry delay.

status_receipt.description: Secret receipt from the original submission response. Accepted only as a tool argument.

tools.name: submit_project
tools.title: Submit a project for review
tools.description: Submits a project homepage to RoboDebut's directory for manual operator review. Intended for submissions the user has authorized, after the required visible followed RoboDebut badge is deployed on that homepage. Runs a bounded check of the public homepage HTML for the badge. A badge does not prove ownership. A submission check can also lead to a site icon fetch, a third-party domain rating lookup and a private operator notice. Requires the user's contact email. Creates a new unapproved submission, or rechecks an eligible earlier submission for the same domain after a failed homepage check or an expired check reservation and updates its stored check result. Never edits submitted details, approves or publishes a listing. A domain already awaiting review returns pending_review unchanged, and rejected domains are not accepted.

homepage_url.description: Public HTTPS apex or www homepage, without credentials or a custom port. Shared service validation normalizes to the root and registrable domain.

contact_email.description: A contact address supplied by the user for this listing. It is used for operator review, private Telegram notices when configured, badge reminders and approval email. RoboDebut excludes it from public listings, submission and status responses, server logs and analytics. The calling MCP client also handles this input.
